notes.title: Demo of our new game!
notes.content: [h3]🐱 [b]Hellbrella[/b] is a fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a Cat in a Raincoat fighting hordes of demons using an umbrella to survive![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833379/f95ccbb6c717ffc80d06b6bfaa12ab0255cbff8b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833379/9b74e9676edae063df5161df8a2753e127608cd4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]❤️ Don't forget to rate the demo. This helps a lot with development and thank you very much for continuing to follow our projects [/h3][p][/p][h3]🔗 [url="https://https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510060/Hellbrella" style="button"]LINK DA DEMO[/url][/h3]
